SELECT
b.client_name, c.pet_name, d.department_name, e.doctor_name, a.is_suc FROM appointment a, client b, pet c, department d, doctor e WHERE a.is_del = 0 AND a.client_id = b.client_id AND a.pet_id = c.pet_id AND a.department_id = d.department_id AND a.doctor_id = e.doctor_id
and (b.client_name like #{seaKw} or b.client_tel like #{seaKw})
and (c.pet_Name like #{seaKw} or c.pet_variety like #{seaKw})
and (e.doctor_name like #{seaKw} or e.doctor_tel like #{seaKw})
and d.department_name like #{seaKw}
order by appointment_date desc

SELECT appointment_id, appointment_date, appointment_info, b.client_name, c.pet_name FROM appointment a, client b, pet c WHERE a.is_del = 0 AND a.client_id = b.client_id AND a.pet_id = c.pet_id AND doctor_id = #{doctorId}
order by appointment_date desc LIMIT 200

SELECT
b.doctor_name, c.pet_name, d.department_name FROM appointment a, doctor b, pet c, department d WHERE a.is_del = 0 AND a.doctor_id = b.doctor_id AND a.pet_id = c.pet_id AND a.department_id = d.department_id AND a.client_id = #{clientId} order by appointment_date desc LIMIT 300
